name: convertToUpper
description: If true, convert the content to uppercase.

name: numChildren
description: The number of children to create from the transform many action.

name: didErrorPrefix
description: Override the default DID prefix (44) that may trigger an error by HelloWorldCppTransformAction.

name: didFilterPrefix
description: Override the default DID prefix (2) that may trigger filtering by HelloWorldCppTransformAction.

name: alwaysErrorOnPrefixHit
description:
If true, an error will occur by HelloWorldCppTransformAction every time the didErrorPrefix is matched.
If false, the error will occur randomly.

name: alwaysFilterOnPrefixHit
description:
If true, filtering will occur by HelloWorldCppTransformAction every time the didFilterPrefix is matched.
If false, the filtering will occur randomly.
